text_block_list.text:
Responding to a summons from Ikuno Dictus, 
I found Biwa Hayahide and Zenno Rob Roy 
there as well. Just what could have 
happened?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, this is an emergency...! 
Royce-san's glasses are missing!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Royce continues the search, but has yet to 
find anything... I'd like to help out.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh no...! An Umamusume's racing glasses 
are custom-made to withstand all kinds of 
race environments. They're not something 
you can easily replace...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your cooperation. Now, 
Operation: Glasses Search, begin!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
According to Royce-san, after finishing 
training, she washed her face, and when 
she went to put them back on, they were 
gone...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I don't see it. Based on Royce-kun's 
movements, I thought the probability of 
dropping it around here was high, but...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"The Mystery of the Missing Glasses... I 
believe in this mystery as well, the 
murder weapon vanished from the scene."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The watermelon murder weapon was eaten by 
a forest bear—a shocking vanishing act! 
Could something similar have happened to 
the glasses...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... Even after searching this much, 
there's no sign of it. Perhaps I should 
consider possibilities other than dropping 
it."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Then while continuing the search, let's 
also add asking around for information to 
our tasks.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Adjustments complete. I've 
re-evaluated the search area and 
redistributed tasks."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Dividing the tasks should improve 
efficiency. I will send the new 
assignments via email, so please check 
them.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —We will find it, without fail.

We searched everywhere, but found 
nothing... With every passing moment, time 
continues to slip away.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Even after searching this much, I still 
can't find it... Just why...?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hello... Is this Royce? I'm sorry, not 
yet—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you, that's plenty. Spending any 
more time on this isn't worth the cost. 
Pull out."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, I cannot give up. You must know all 
too well from experience just how 
inconvenient it is without glasses.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno-kun is right. For us, it is no 
exaggeration to say that glasses are part 
of our very bodies!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Without my glasses, running is out of the 
question—I can barely even walk straight!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even my everyday clothes and hairstyle are 
coordinated based on having glasses...! 
And now all of that is completely 
ruined...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Those who do not wear glasses may say they 
are 'just glasses.' But to us, they are 
something more.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Covered in sweat at times, catching tears 
at others— a partner of the heart who 
shared every memory.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—That's why, Royce... As a fellow lover of 
glasses... Please let me fight by your 
side to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "‘Everyone...! Thank you so, so much—!’"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Let's keep up the good work, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Hayahide & Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ooh!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... This is the last place on the 
list. It hasn't... been dropped here, has 
it...?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Staying focused for this long is 
exhausting. Time for a little stretch...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm? There's something glowing at the tip 
of that tree branch—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: !! Th-That's—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah, welcome back, my glasses! And here I 
thought they were gone forever...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It was actually up in a tree. It seems a 
crow carried it off, of all things.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What a shocker! They must've swiped it 
while I was washing my face!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for finding it even though 
it was in a place like that...! Thank you 
so, so much!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"That's right, let's make a toast! As a 
token of my gratitude, it's my treat!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Physically, I had plenty left in the tank. 
Mental-wise, I didn't feel any anxiety 
either.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Everyone shared the very same passion for 
glasses, after all!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We were able to unite and search 
together. Thank you so much for your hard 
work, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It was a day to reflect on and 
appreciate glasses. We are kept alive by 
our glasses—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
With all those feelings in your hearts, 
please chant along with me! Ready, go!!

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Glasses Forever!
